item.name: Bank 2
item.cardSummary: Two-part bank with a lobby, teller room, offices, meeting room, and air vents around a central vault. A metal detector between the teller room and the vault sounds an alarm when the Murderer, Sheriff, or Hero walks through, and it replaced the original Bank map.

item.name: Bio Lab
item.cardSummary: One of the largest maps in the pool, built as a laboratory with a giant central tube, an office, a bio-tube room, a workshop, two storage rooms, and a vent system.

item.name: Factory
item.cardSummary: Fairly large industrial map with an outside area, parking room, office, box room, manufacturing floor, and a sewage system. Its open sightlines tend to favor the Sheriff over the Murderer.

item.name: Hospital 3
item.cardSummary: Two-floor hospital added in the Season 1 update as the replacement for Hospital 2. It has a lobby, office area, recovery and X-ray rooms downstairs, an operation room and doctor's office upstairs, and two air vent systems.

item.name: Hotel 2
item.cardSummary: Three-floor hotel with balconies around a central atrium, a cinema, guest rooms, a restaurant with a kitchen and freezer, and a broken elevator shaft in the stairwell. It replaced the original Hotel map in the Season 1 update.

item.name: House 2
item.cardSummary: Revamped version of the original House and one of the most voted maps in the game. The house has a living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, dining room, garage, laundry room, a two-level basement, and a backyard.

item.name: Mansion 2
item.cardSummary: Two-floor mansion with long corridors that players favor for one-on-one duels. Rooms include a kitchen, lounge with a fireplace, meeting room, garage, storage room, and an upstairs bedroom with a hidden passage down to the fireplace. It replaced the original Mansion.

item.name: Mil-Base
item.cardSummary: Fan-favorite military base with a large outdoor crate yard, tanks, and a two-floor building holding a control room, locker room, storage hall, and a meeting room connected by an air shaft.

item.name: Office 3
item.cardSummary: Colorful revamp of Office 2 with a looping layout, a computer room, restroom vents with an elevator, and tight corridors. The extra rooms and loop make it friendlier to Innocents than its predecessor.

item.name: Police Station
item.cardSummary: Large station with a main entrance hall, downstairs garage, two upstairs offices, an interrogation room, and a jail with two cells. A wide vent network connects many rooms, which helps players escape chases.

item.name: Research Facility
item.cardSummary: Interactive lab inspired by Bio Lab where players can pull levers to open the garage, trigger an emergency lockdown with red lights, and shut yellow doors by stabbing an electricity box. It is one of the most voted maps in the game.

item.name: Workplace
item.cardSummary: The oldest map still playable, added two days after the game launched. It is a medium office with a kitchen, computer area, meeting room, storage area, and a long hallway with several dead ends, so hiding spots are scarce.

item.name: Beach Resort
item.cardSummary: Resort hotel on a beach that debuted in the Summer Event 2024 as the first summer event map. It has a reception and lobby, hotel room floors, a bar, an outdoor pool with a slide, and an indoor spa pool below the lobby.

item.name: Pier
item.cardSummary: Carnival pier from the Summer Event 2026 with a Ferris wheel, a walkable roller coaster, concession stands, and game booths. It is the most open map in the game, which makes rounds harder for the Murderer, and falling into the water is fatal.

item.name: Yacht
item.cardSummary: Multi-deck yacht from the Summer Event 2025 with a pool and bar on the sun deck, an arcade and dining room on the main deck, a lower beach club with a hidden cabin vent, and a helicopter pad at the bow. Jumping into the ocean is fatal.

item.name: Barn
item.cardSummary: Halloween remake of the original Barn built for the Infection game mode introduced in the Halloween Event 2022. It is a large open farm with a huge climbable barn, silos, gas tanks, a small house, and pumpkins scattered around.

item.name: Farmhouse
item.cardSummary: Halloween map added alongside Manor in the Halloween Event 2021. The fairly big grounds hold an abandoned mansion, a huge barn, a tractor, a pumpkin patch, and a small underground tunnel.

item.name: Manor
item.cardSummary: Spooky haunted mansion from the Halloween Event 2021 that plays entirely indoors. It has a kitchen, study, two bedrooms, a bathroom, an attic, and a basement, with many vents and hiding spots.

item.name: Mineshaft 2
item.cardSummary: Brighter remake of the removed Mineshaft map, added in the Halloween Event 2022. The cave has water, railways with minecarts, wall crystals, a small sewer tunnel, and a secret room behind a locker, and its Halloween decorations were stripped for its 2025 return.

item.name: Spaceship
item.cardSummary: Spaceship map from the Halloween Event 2025 set in outer space. Metallic corridors with long windows connect a cell room, storage room, cafeteria, kitchen, garden, and a control room with a giant window, with radioactive waste scattered around.

item.name: Vampire's Castle
item.cardSummary: Big, fairly tight castle from the Halloween Event 2024 decorated with paintings of its vampire owner. It includes a library, garden, dining room, kitchen, graves, and a few secret passages.

item.name: Christmas In Italy
item.cardSummary: Christmas revamp of the old Murder Mystery map Italy, introduced in the Christmas Event 2024. The layout keeps the original plaza, colorful European buildings, and sewer, and adds a pizza place, Christmas decorations, and slippery ice.

item.name: Ice Castle
item.cardSummary: Frosted medieval castle from the Christmas Event 2022 that also returned in later Christmas events. It has a snowy inner ward with a wishing well, a throne hall, bedrooms, a conference room, a dining room, balconies, and a dungeon basement.

item.name: Log Cabin
item.cardSummary: Wooden cabin from the Christmas Event 2020 that has returned in later Christmas events. It has a basement with a gift storage room, a main floor with a kitchen, living room, and Christmas tree, an upstairs with bedrooms and bathrooms, and a snowy yard.

item.name: Ski Lodge
item.cardSummary: Enormous ski lodge introduced in the Christmas Event 2023, with a living room, a ski rental, Christmas trees, and piles of gifts. Players can go outside and sit in an idle zip-wire seat overlooking the slope.

item.name: Ski Village
item.cardSummary: Snowy village map introduced in the Christmas Event 2025, joining the Christmas lineup alongside maps like Workshop, Log Cabin, and Train Station.

item.name: Train Station
item.cardSummary: Christmas map introduced in the Christmas Event 2021 that has returned in every Christmas event since. The station has a restaurant, a clothing store, restrooms, and a large outdoor boarding area with a two-car train on the tracks.

item.name: Workshop
item.cardSummary: The first seasonal map in the game, released with the Christmas Event 2019 as the toy workshop of Saint Nikilis and his elves. It has a gift wrapping station, an office, a storage area, a break room, tunnels, and a garage.

item.name: Bank
item.cardSummary: Original bank map that introduced the metal detector alarm mechanic later kept in Bank 2. It featured a teller room and a vault only the Sheriff could open, and it left the game when Bank 2 arrived in October 2018.

item.name: Barn (original)
item.cardSummary: Early farm map used only in the Wild West and Infection Bonus Rounds, with a climbable three-floor barn, gas tanks, and a distant house. It left the game when Bonus Rounds were discontinued in December 2015, and its layout later returned as the Halloween Barn remake.

item.name: Hospital
item.cardSummary: Detailed revamp of the Murder Mystery 1 hospital with a lobby, three patient rooms, a surgery room, and an office. Its small size and lack of hiding spots made it easy for the Murderer, and Hospital 2 replaced it in February 2017.

item.name: Hospital 2
item.cardSummary: Larger, calmer hospital with a muted color scheme, a lobby, office, patient rooms, a surgery room, and air vents. It was replaced by Hospital 3 in the Season 1 update.

item.name: Hotel
item.cardSummary: Three-floor hotel revamped from its Murder Mystery 1 predecessor, with a lobby and bar, a restaurant with a freezer, open guest rooms, and a cinema with a projector room. Hotel 2 replaced it in the Season 1 update.

item.name: House
item.cardSummary: Small launch-day house map with a living room, kitchen, bedroom, garage, laundry room, and basement. It was revamped into House 2 in January 2016 and stayed in the pool until mid 2016 before being removed.

item.name: Lab 2
item.cardSummary: Launch-day revamp of The Lab from Murder Mystery 1, known for its dull grey rooms and confusing layout. It was removed in the Season 1 update in May 2019, when nSOffice took its place.

item.name: Mansion
item.cardSummary: Launch-day mansion with a bathroom, a lounge with a large table, a closet, and a computer lab. It was a fairly small map with a normal amount of hiding spots, and Mansion 2 replaced it in April 2017.

item.name: Mil-Base (original)
item.cardSummary: Short-lived early base map added alongside Workplace and removed about ten days later after the Bonus Rounds update. It was rarely voted for, footage of it is hard to find, and the current Mil-Base replaced it in late 2015.

item.name: Mineshaft
item.cardSummary: Dark circular cave map with railways, minecarts, a red smoke room, and a secret office behind a locker. It was removed in 2018 due to R15 complications and later remade as Mineshaft 2 for the Halloween Event 2022.

item.name: nSOffice
item.cardSummary: Modern office based on the nStudio group, with a lobby playground, meeting room, cafeteria, and an underground hard-drive storage basement. It replaced Lab 2 in the Season 1 update and was discontinued in April 2024, mainly over lag issues.

item.name: Office 2
item.cardSummary: Launch-day revamp of the Murder Mystery 1 office, widely disliked for its tiny size, dead ends, and lack of hiding spots. Office 3 arrived as its updated version in 2016, and Office 2 itself was removed in the Halloween 2021 update.

item.name: Pond
item.cardSummary: Early outdoor map used only in the Juggernaut, Massacre, and Hot Potato Bonus Rounds. Like Barn, it left the game when Bonus Rounds were removed in December 2015.
